titre: Nexora WorkStudio · Rien ne part sans vous
idee: Les agents lisent, trient et préparent ; puis ils s'arrêtent et attendent votre accord.

aube.image: Dawn in a bright, minimal Montreal apartment kitchen: a woman in her mid-forties, owner of a small business, sits at a pale wooden table by a large window, a closed plain unbranded laptop with a blank lid in front of her; her phone lies face-down on the table and glows softly at its edges as it vibrates. She looks at it calmly, unhurried. Soft blue-gold window light, bright airy interior, plants, lifted shadows, natural skin, 35mm, shallow depth of field.
aube.mouvement: Slow push-in; the phone glows twice; she glances at it, then out of the window, composed.
aube.son: Quiet early morning room tone, a phone vibrating softly on wood, distant birds.

ecran.image: Close-up from the front side of the same woman at a pale wooden table at dawn as she opens a plain unbranded matte grey laptop with a blank lid and no logo; the camera faces her, the screen faces away from camera; its cool light gently reaches her calm face. Bright window light behind, minimal, calm, shallow depth of field.
ecran.mouvement: The lid opens smoothly; the camera holds, then drifts slightly closer.
ecran.son: A soft laptop hinge, quiet room tone.

sortie.image: Medium shot: the same woman in her mid-forties, shoulder-length brown hair, olive shirt and light coat, steps out of her front door onto the outdoor staircase of a Montreal brick triplex on a bright autumn morning, leather bag on her shoulder, relaxed confident smile; golden leaves, warm low sunlight on her face.
sortie.mouvement: Gentle tracking shot as she walks down the steps into the sunlight; easy, light.
sortie.son: Morning street ambience, footsteps, light breeze in leaves.

narration.texte: Cette nuit, le courrier a continué d'entrer.
WorkStudio l'a lu, trié… et il a préparé les réponses.
narration.dit: Work Studio l'a lu, trié… et il a préparé les réponses.

narration.texte: Vos agents font le travail. Vous gardez le dernier mot.

musique.prompt: A 55-second instrumental for a premium, Apple-style product film about work that gets prepared overnight and waits for a human's approval. Quiet, precise, modern and warm. 0-6 s: near silence, soft air and one felt-piano note. 6-14 s: a delicate analog-synth pulse at 90 BPM with soft felt piano, gently moving forward. 14-24 s: suspense, the music almost stops, only a held low note and space. At 25 s: one deep soft hit then a warm release with light percussion and round bass, bright and relieved, until 36 s. 36-46 s: calm, spacious resolution on a single warm chord; clean ending by 47 s. No vocals, no risers, no cliches.
